decisions.decision: Changed theme_mainline_identity_registry PK from (subject_key) to (subject_key, source_trade_date) for per-date independent rows

decisions.decision: Relaxed ThemeCycleJudgementService L335 identity gate to allow prior_alive + has_rank subjects, not just current confirmed
decisions.reason: Gate was blocking non-confirmed subjects from entering cycle computation, preventing abnormal/new themes from ever becoming mainlines

decisions.decision: Implemented 4-tier LLM call strategy: inherited→skip, bootstrap→skip, rule_mt→LLM API, near_threshold→LLM API, cold→deterministic
decisions.reason: Design doc §24 specifies LLM only needed for specific scenarios, not all subjects

decisions.decision: Created MainlineIdentityUniverseBuilder with 6 sources: confirmed, prior_alive, hot_rank, abnormal, new_theme, cluster
decisions.reason: Old chain scanned all 661 subjects; new chain should only track ~30-50 candidates (confirmed + alive + hot + abnormal)

decisions.decision: Enhanced Guard 2 to protect identity_status changes for confirmed subjects (not just is_main_theme=false)
decisions.reason: Inherited subjects could have identity_status changed from confirmed to review_pending by upgrade_trigger path

decisions.decision: Use BuildPostMarketRecapJob directly (not simplified rebuild) for C layer — remove hand-rolled rebuild_c_layer function
decisions.reason: User required no fallback/simulation — must use real new chain Job pipeline

decisions.reason: get_strong_watch_seed_rows complex CTE query with 50K+ row tables needed >30s to complete
